## Lattices

### `array.contract`

What an array promises in each zarr format: every lossless codec pipeline and every edge fill value round-trips bit for bit, indexing matches numpy, a checksum codec turns a corrupt chunk into an error, and shrinking then growing an array never brings old data back.

| `codec_roundtrip` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `fill_values` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `indexing` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `checksum_detects_corruption` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `resize_no_resurrection` | ☑️ | ☑️ |

### `store.contract`

What every store must do for zarr, checked per store in both zarr formats. chunk_count_with_siblings and delete_keeps_siblings use arrays named lat and lat_bnds, the CF naming pattern. byte_range_edges asks for empty and past-the-end ranges, which must return empty bytes like MemoryStore does.
